scripts.mock:status: pgrep -f 'mockoon-cli' > /dev/null && (echo 'Mockoon is running' && ps wwaux | grep '[m]ockoon-cli' | grep -v 'mock:status' | while read -r p; do PID=$(echo $p | awk '{print $2}'); PORT=$(echo $p | grep -oE '(--port|-p) [0-9]+' | awk '{print $2}'); echo "   PID: $PID | URL: http://localhost:${PORT:-3000}"; done | sort -u -k2,2) || echo 'Mockoon server is not running'
